name: Westfield Culver City
description: Westfield Culver City is the ultimate destination for food, fashion and fun in Los Angeles' Westside. This premier shopping center features major department store anchors including Macy's, JCPenney, and Nordstrom Rack, alongside popular retailers like Target, H&M, Sephora, UNIQLO, and Ulta Beauty. With diverse dining options, entertainment venues including Activate gaming facility, and convenient amenities like EV charging and free Wi-Fi, it offers a complete shopping and leisure experience.
summary: A premier Westside Los Angeles regional mall featuring major department stores, diverse retail and dining options, and entertainment attractions.
